exposure: Atrial switch operation (ASO) for transposition of the great arteries (TGA)
outcome: Cardiac complications (deterioration of right ventricular function, heart failure, supraventricular tachyarrhythmia, sick sinus syndrome, hemoptysis)
cohort: 30 pregnancies in 15 patients who underwent ASO for TGA at a single institution between 2004 and 2019
finding: Pregnant patients with TGA after ASO had a high incidence of preterm cesarean section and cardiac complications, including deterioration of right ventricular function.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery in 16 out of 21 live births (76%).
